verdict.rationale: Zapier ships an official, first-party hosted MCP server, and its docs cover it in depth. Any MCP client (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) connects by creating a server and adding a connection token as a Bearer header or query parameter. The docs also cover agentic vs. managed modes, team server access, shareable tool bundles, and SOC 2 security with SSO, OAuth and token auth; a probe confirms the server is documented at zapier.com/mcp. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that agents connect and work reliably through the MCP server.
